solve_isolate_variable: solve a sympy relational expression to isolate a variable on the left-hand side using try_solve
mirror_relational_operator: mirror a sympy relational operator type to its flipped counterpart using mirror_rel_op
isolate_floor_div_inequality: isolate a FloorDiv inequality by converting it to equivalent And or Or constraints
remove_constants_lhs: remove constant terms from the left-hand side of a sympy relational expression
divide_lhs_by_factor: divide both sides of a relational expression by factors not containing the target variable
